name: Do energy-efficient upgrades increase my home's value?

mainEntity.name: Do energy-efficient upgrades increase my home's value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, energy-efficient upgrades can significantly increase your home's value. Features like new windows, upgraded insulation, and high-efficiency HVAC systems are attractive to potential buyers, as they promise lower utility costs and improved comfort. A certified energy rating (like an HERS rating) can further demonstrate these improvements. The exact return on investment varies, but properties with documented energy-saving features often command higher prices in markets like San Leandro and Union City.
acceptedAnswer.description: Energy-efficient upgrades can increase home value by lowering utility costs and improving comfort, which is attractive to buyers.
